name: vsday
displayName: VSDay — Font Size & Day/Night/Eye-Saving/High Contrast Modes
description: Scale the font size of every VS Code surface with one keystroke, and switch between Day, Night, Eye-Saving and High Contrast appearance modes.
author: Andrey Sadovykh

commands.title: Use Current Font Sizes as the New 100%
Cycle Appearance Mode (Day → Night → Eye-Saving → High Contrast)
Reset Everything (Font Size and Appearance Mode)

vsday.fontScale.step.markdownDescription: Current font scale step. `0` means 100% (your captured baseline). Managed by the VSDay commands; you can also set it by hand.

vsday.fontScale.ratio.markdownDescription: Growth factor applied per scale step. `1.1` means each step is about 10% larger. Sizes are always recomputed from the baseline, so changing this never accumulates rounding drift.

vsday.fontScale.baselines.markdownDescription: The 100% font size for each target setting, captured from your own configuration the first time you scale. Run **VSDay: Use Current Font Sizes as the New 100%** to re-capture.

vsday.fontScale.extraTargets.markdownDescription: Additional font-size settings to scale alongside the built-in ones, e.g. `myExtension.fontSize`. Unregistered settings are skipped with a warning in the VSDay log.

vsday.uiZoom.enabled.markdownDescription: Also nudge `#window.zoomLevel#` when scaling, so workbench chrome (tabs, side bar, status bar) keeps up with the text. VS Code offers no font-size setting for chrome, so zoom is the only lever.

vsday.uiZoom.perStep.markdownDescription: Zoom levels added per font scale step. Kept small on purpose: zoom already magnifies text, so a full zoom level per step would compound with the font increase. One full zoom level is +20%.

vsday.mode.active.description: The appearance mode VSDay currently has applied.

vsday.mode.cycleOrder.description: Order in which the Cycle Appearance Mode command rotates through modes. Remove an entry to skip that mode when cycling.

vsday.mode.day.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme applied by Day mode, named exactly as in **Preferences: Color Theme**. Leave empty to use the best light theme this VS Code version ships (`Light 2026`, `Light Modern`, `Default Light Modern`, …) — VS Code has renamed its default themes across releases, so the automatic choice is the portable one.

vsday.mode.day.settings.markdownDescription: Extra settings applied while Day mode is active, and reverted to their previous values when you leave it.

vsday.mode.night.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme applied by Night mode. Leave empty to use the best dark theme this VS Code version ships (`Dark 2026`, `Dark Modern`, `Default Dark Modern`, …), or set `VSDay Warm Dark` for a low-blue-light dark theme.

vsday.mode.night.settings.markdownDescription: Extra settings applied while Night mode is active, and reverted to their previous values when you leave it.

vsday.mode.eyeSaving.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme applied by Eye-Saving mode. Defaults to the warm, low-blue-light theme bundled with VSDay.

vsday.mode.eyeSaving.settings.markdownDescription: Extra settings applied while Eye-Saving mode is active, and reverted to their previous values when you leave it.

vsday.mode.highContrast.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme applied by High Contrast mode. Defaults to the warm high-contrast theme bundled with VSDay — the sepia ground with near-black text and hard borders. Set `Default High Contrast Light` or `Default High Contrast` for VS Code's own.

vsday.mode.highContrast.settings.markdownDescription: Extra settings applied while High Contrast mode is active, and reverted to their previous values when you leave it. Heavier text and a wider cursor do as much for legibility as the colours do.

vsday.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the VSDay status bar controls.

vsday.statusBar.showStepButtons.markdownDescription: Show the `−` and `+` buttons either side of the scale percentage in the status bar.

vsday.statusBar.showModeButton.markdownDescription: Show the appearance mode button in the status bar. Clicking it switches to the next mode in `#vsday.mode.cycleOrder#`.

enumDescriptions: Show the reset dot only while the font scale is away from 100%.
vsday.statusBar.showResetDot.description: When to show the one-click reset dot next to the VSDay status bar item.
